scope: Bounded primary-source methods and implementation review, not an exhaustive systematic review.

sources.title: PP-OCRv6 / official PaddleOCR.js
sources.method: Text detector → polygon crop → CTC recognition; NRTR training branch is discarded at inference. Separate detector and recognizer evidence is useful.
sources.reportedMeasurement: 200 general-scene/document images including disk I/O and pre/postprocessing. PP-OCRv6 small: native ONNX Runtime 1.23.2 Apple M4 1.29 s/image; tiny 0.35 s/image. Neither is a browser/phone or board-game benchmark.
sources.license: Official code Apache-2.0; selected small det/rec ONNX model cards also Apache-2.0.
sources.versions: Repository dab3fe3 (2026-09-16); JS package metadata 0.4.2, onnxruntime-web ^1.22.0. Paper June 2026. Implementation/version and benchmark backend are not identical.
sources.availability: Official JS Worker implementation with WebGPU/WASM backend selection. Two HF ONNX files listed as 21.2 MB recognition +9.88 MB detection; not downloaded. Runtime and image memory are additional.

code.inspection: Det+rec assets load in parallel; detector boxes drive cropByPoly. predict returns text items only when rec.text exists and score passes; empty box coordinates are not exposed in high-level result.
Greedy CTC decode with mean character probability; score is not a calibrated board-state correctness probability.
Polygon detection postprocessing is a distinct stage. Exported package index exposes types, not the createDetModel factory.
Module Worker isolates processing; runtime/asset URLs must be version-pinned.
Auto can use WebGPU or WASM; explicit GPU failure is not proof all clients support GPU.
Fetches complete tar bytes and extracts ONNX/yml. SDK does not implement a persistent model cache itself.

sources.transferLimit: Text regions are not physical object footprints; no dice-pip/meeple/card-identity guarantee. CTC scores do not fix 6/9. Selected unified language list does not establish Korean support; use separately verified Korean assets if needed. Phone cold/warm latency, rotation and game-font accuracy UNKNOWN.

sources.title: Determining Chess Game State from an Image / chesscog
sources.method: RANSAC/grid localization → occupancy classifier → piece classifier; context around a square matters. Novel piece appearance is adapted using known starting-position images.
sources.reportedMeasurement: Authors report just over 2 s on Intel i5-6500 3.20GHz quad-core, under 0.5 s on GTX1060 6GB. New-piece evaluation has 27 real board images: without adaptation 9.33 errors/board; after adaptation 0.11 and 88.89% perfect boards. Not generic zero-shot recognition.
sources.license: Code MIT; separately downloadable pretrained weights were not downloaded or license-audited in this task.
sources.versions: Pinned master 4e9c22d (2025-01-11); paper 2021; old Python/PyTorch dependency stack requires maintenance.
sources.availability: Working academic/personal public code, not evidence of a production 120-game service.

code.inspection: Canny/Hough lines followed by grid/RANSAC reasoning; strongly depends on chess-board structure.
64-square occupancy precedes piece classification; illegal-board warning does not rewrite values into a legal state.

sources.transferLimit: Known board geometry can constrain coordinates, not hidden occupancy. Catan hexes, variable tiles and freely placed card rows need different geometric evidence. Starting inventory labels must not enter midgame requests.

sources.title: SAHI: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference
sources.method: Overlapping slices are resized for an existing detector, shifted back to source coordinates and merged; optional whole-image detection preserves large-object context.
sources.reportedMeasurement: VisDrone AP50 improvements from slicing alone: +6.8/+5.1/+5.3 points for FCOS/VFNet/TOOD. Evaluated 640x640 VisDrone or 400x400 xView slices with detector scaling. Large-object fragmentation and overlap tradeoffs remain.
sources.versions: Canonical main b5a153e (2026-10-16). Small-Object-Detection/SAHI inspected metadata is a stale fork and excluded from current-code claims.
sources.availability: Python wrapper around a detector; neither a trained game-object model nor an API parallel-scheduling framework.

code.inspection: Calls detector on slices, shifts boxes to source, optionally runs full image, then postprocesses.
NMS discards and NMM may merge clusters; these cannot directly preserve KeepBoard layers, conflicting values and immutable evidence.

sources.transferLimit: Detection AP is not VLM board-state accuracy. More crops add work and repeated image tokens. Existing KeepBoard exact crop transforms should be reused; no universal IoU or overlap copied as product truth.

sources.title: YOLO-World
sources.method: Text/image region alignment and offline vocabulary reparameterization; outputs object boxes/classes, not full semantic game state.
sources.reportedMeasurement: YOLO-World-L reports 35.4 AP on LVIS minival and 52 FPS on NVIDIA V100 with reparameterized vocabulary. Not CPU/mobile timing or small game numeral accuracy.
sources.license: Official repo GPL-3.0; commercial licensing path mentioned by maintainers. Do not assume a wrapper relicenses the model.
sources.versions: Pinned official main 4f70adb (2025-02-26). Static AST parsing of yolo_world.py at this revision fails at line61; downloaded implementation was never executed.
sources.availability: Official weights and ONNX example exist; this inspected main is not a verified deployable runtime. No managed endpoint authentication or account availability tested.

code.inspection: Caches text features and emits detections; exact main parse failure recorded in offline-audit.json.
Uses 640x640 preprocessing and ONNX; one postprocessing path explicitly moves tensors to cuda:0. Not an out-of-box browser implementation.

sources.transferLimit: Common noun prompts may find cards/dice, but must measure game-piece recall, adjacent-object splits and false positives. No implied card identity, ownership or numeral decoding.

sources.title: V*: Guided Visual Search / SEAL
sources.method: Target-conditioned priority search over subimages and visual working memory; separates search from downstream question answering.
sources.reportedMeasurement: V*Bench VQA overall 75.39 vs GPT-4V 54.97; mean search 6.0 s/target on one A100. Guided search 4.65 steps vs BFS6.62. Neither is whole-object recall or phone/API latency.
sources.license: Repo MIT; Vicuna/LLaVA/search model checkpoint conditions are separate and not established as one permissive product bundle here.
sources.availability: CUDA/BF16 7B-based research stack, not a cheap CPU local pass.

code.inspection: Target detections stop search; multiple-instance return is limited to the whole-image branch. Weak heatmap can trigger a common-sense search cue, then four-way subdivision.

sources.transferLimit: A question-specific search cannot certify that every repeated game piece was found. Commonsense expected locations are search hypotheses, not observed coordinates. Avoid recursive paid search agents.

sources.title: LLaVA-UHD
sources.method: Aspect-aware tiling plus overview, learned visual resampler and explicit spatial separators; 576 visual tokens per slice compressed to64.
sources.reportedMeasurement: Paper evaluates a CLIP ViT-L/14 + Vicuna13B model, up to six slices plus overview at 672x1008. Training uses 8 A100 GPUs. Its visual-token compression is learned inside the model.
sources.license: Repo Apache-2.0; individual base/checkpoint licenses remain separate.
sources.versions: Inspected current repo aa2dac5 (2026-07-06) includes UHD v3 announcements and retained v1 modules. Not claimed to be the exact 2024 benchmark checkout.
sources.availability: Self-hosted/trainable model architecture; not a switch exposed by Terra's public API.

code.inspection: Returns overview, patches and grid; preserves spatial sequence.
Learned queries/cross-attention compress visual tokens. External crop/atlas cannot reproduce this billing/compute effect.

sources.transferLimit: Not evidence that sending many crops to Terra is cheaper/faster. Cannot control Terra internal layer exits/resampler.

sources.title: RouteLLM
sources.method: Learn prompt-conditioned preference between stronger and weaker language models; calibrate threshold for desired strong-model call share.
sources.reportedMeasurement: Arena-trained routers are near random on MMLU and below random APGR on GSM8K; domain-related augmentation improves them. Language-task results do not calibrate vision correctness.
sources.availability: MF implementation uses text-embedding-3-small via an API plus a learned model; it is not a no-call geometric router.

code.inspection: Chooses score quantile to reach call proportion; not an accuracy guarantee.
Calls embedding API and scores relative model preference, not factual visual observations.

sources.transferLimit: Use explicit evidence-gap reasons now. Evaluate false-safe cases and missed objects; do not treat model confidence or agreement as truth.

sources.title: OpenCV planar feature matching + homography
sources.method: Estimate a planar projective transform from visual point correspondences. Official tutorial uses SURF; mentions ORB/KAZE alternatives.
sources.reportedMeasurement: No board-game performance benchmark in this tutorial.
sources.license: Official documentation/code example inspected; no new OpenCV build shipped. Any chosen JS distribution/version must retain its license notices.
sources.versions: Documentation resolved to4.13.0; existing Paddle JS dependency specifies OpenCV.js4.10 series.
sources.availability: Geometry can run locally; robust matching still needs visible distinctive correspondences.
sources.transferLimit: Repeated tiles, occlusion, mirrored rotations and raised pieces can invalidate registration. Exact same-source crop mapping is different from inferred cross-view matching.

sources.title: OpenAI Terra / image / latency / streaming API contracts
sources.method: Hosted image input with reasoning configuration and structured output; multiple images supported by API, not by current KeepBoard compiler.
sources.reportedMeasurement: Official latency advice is general guidance, not KeepBoard measurement. No 30s guarantee, no reported Terra game-state benchmark.
sources.license: Commercial API terms/pricing; no downloadable model/runtime assumed.
sources.versions: Official pages fetched 2026-10-31 via OpenAI docs tools. gpt-6.1-terra supports none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max. Current KeepBoard pinned product profile remains low.
sources.availability: Streaming and structured outputs supported. Every image contributes input tokens. Model-specific image sizing/multiplier for6.1 Terra was not established from the general vision table.
sources.transferLimit: Cannot configure internal early-exit/visual resampler. Streaming partial JSON is not a valid editable board. HTTP abort is not a refund contract. No live calls or account inspection in this task.
